mentions.name: Stabilizer
mentions.description: Effort to resurrect Stabilizer, a tool that makes program performance less dependent on the linker and layout lottery, which has fallen victim to bitrot.
mentions.problem: The original tool has fallen victim to bitrot.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also working on resurrecting stabilizer (https://github.com/matthiasgoergens/stabilizer).  Stabilizer is a way to make program performance less dependent on the linker and layout lottery.  But it has sadly fallen victim to bitrot.
mentions.author: eru
